subsection_headings: Both Buildings and Contents (Main cover exclusions)
text:
Empty homes: Loss or damage under many sections of your policy if your home is left unoccupied for more than 60 days.

People you know: Malicious damage, theft or attempted theft caused by you, your family or anybody invited into the property unless force and violence has been used to enter your home.

Escape of water: As the result of taps being left on (this may be covered if you have added Accidental Damage Cover).

Pets: Loss or damage caused by chewing, scratching, tearing, fouling or vomiting by domestic pets.

Gradually operating causes: Any loss or damage caused by anything that happens gradually including wear and tear.

title: Gold Home Insurance Policy
section_heading: Are there any restrictions on cover?
text:
Limits: Limits apply to all sections of your policy. We will not pay more than the 'Unspecified item limit' for high risk items not listed individually on your Policy Schedule. High risk items are defined in your policy booklet.

Excesses: You must pay the first part of any claim (the excess). The excess is made up of the Compulsory excess, plus your chosen Voluntary excess. The excess for Subsidence, Escape of Water and Flood replace the compulsory excess. Your compulsory excess amount and all other excesses are shown on your Policy Schedule.

Extra conditions: Such as minimum security requirements (use of your locks and security devices) may apply. If applicable, these will appear on your Policy Schedule. If you do not keep to Extra Conditions it could affect your claim settlement.

Matching Suites: We will treat an individual item from a matching set of items as a single item. We will only pay for items that are lost or damaged but not for the other pieces of the set or suite which are not damaged or lost.

title: Home Emergency Cover
section_heading: What is this type of insurance?
text: Home Emergency Cover provides assistance for the emergencies specified in this policy. For example, broken boilers, burst pipes, broken windows, doors and locks. It is not intended to replace the normal day-to-day maintenance of your home. We'll help to arrange and pay for any work needed to make a temporary repair to resolve the emergency in your home. You'll be covered for up to £500 per claim with no excess to pay.

Title: Home Emergency Cover
Document type: insurance_product_information

Section: What is this type of insurance?

Home Emergency Cover provides assistance for the emergencies specified in this policy. For example, broken boilers, burst pipes, broken windows, doors and locks. title: Home Emergency Cover
text:
We'll provide up to £500 for call out charges, labour, parts and materials to carry out a temporary repair to the following emergencies.

Plumbing: We'll cover issues relating to water pipes inside your home, including pipes connected to your shower or bath, internal overflow pipes and leaks from your toilet. We'll also cover a failure of the toilet flush mechanism.

Drainage: We'll cover blocked waste pipes or drains that are your sole responsibility, including blocked sinks, baths, toilets, rainwater drains and soil vent pipes.

Electrics: We'll cover failure of your electricity supply.

Windows, doors and locks: We'll secure broken external windows, doors and locks.

Boiler and heating system: We'll cover your boiler, heating system or hot-water system if it fails or breaks down because of:
- An emergency, leaving you without heating or hot water.
- A loss of water pressure within a boiler due to a fault.
- A water leak from the boiler or heating system.

Accommodation: We'll pay up to £500 for accommodation and transport if your home remains uninhabitable overnight. The maximum we will pay per night is £250.

Temporary heating: We'll pay you up to £50 towards the cost of heaters if you have no heating and the engineer is waiting for parts.

Unlimited claims: There is no limit on the number of claims you can make in each policy term.

title: Home Emergency Cover
text:
Claim notification: We won't cover any emergency not reported to us within 4 days of it being discovered.

Boiler and heating: We won't cover underfloor heating systems and commercial boilers or heating systems with an output of over 70kW/hr.

Boiler located outside of your home: We won't cover any boiler or heating system outside your home, unless this provides the main source of heating for your home.

Electrics: We won't cover an intermittent failure to the electrics within your home.

Windows, doors and locks: We won't cover internal doors and windows that do not affect the security and safety of the property. We won't cover replacing lost or stolen keys.

Plumbing: We won't cover pipes outside your home, dripping taps, domestic appliances, or frozen pipes where no damage has occurred.

Drainage: We won't cover shared or local water-authority drains, manholes, soakaways, cesspits, guttering or downpipes, treatment plants or septic tanks, or drains that aren't totally blocked.

Trace and access: We won't cover the cost of work to find the source of the emergency.

Maintenance: We won't cover normal maintenance that should be carried out.

Section: What is not insured?

Claim notification: We won't cover any emergency not reported to us within 4 days of it being discovered.

Boiler and heating: We won't cover underfloor heating systems and commercial boilers or heating systems with an output of over 70kW/hr.

Boiler located outside of your home: We won't cover any boiler or heating system outside your home, unless this provides the main source of heating for your home.

Electrics: We won't cover an intermittent failure to the electrics within your home.

Windows, doors and locks: We won't cover internal doors and windows that do not affect the security and safety of the property. We won't cover replacing lost or stolen keys.

Plumbing: We won't cover pipes outside your home, dripping taps, domestic appliances, or frozen pipes where no damaged has occurred.

Drainage: We won't cover shared or local water-authority drains, manholes, soakaways, cesspits, guttering or downpipes, treatment plants or septic tanks, or drains that aren't totally blocked.

Pests: We won't cover pests found outside your home.

Roofing: We won't cover damage to chimneys or guttering.

Trace and Access: We won't cover the cost of work to find the source of the emergency.

Maintenance: We won't cover normal maintenance that should be carried out.

title: Home Legal Expenses
text:
Employment disputes: Disputes relating to your employment contract.

Personal injury: Sudden or specific accidents causing your death or bodily injury.

Clinical negligence: A negligent surgical act, or clinical or medical procedure causing your death or bodily injury.

Consumer disputes: Disputes over:
- Buying or selling or renting the home you live in.
- Buying or selling goods.
- Purchasing services.

Motor Contract disputes: Disputes over:
- Buying, selling, hiring or insurance of a motor vehicle or its spare parts or accessories.
- Service, repair or testing of the insured vehicle.

Property disputes: Disputes relating to your main home or personal possessions following:
- Someone causing damage to them.
- Legal nuisance or trespass.

Probate: Disputes relating to the will of your parents, grandparents, children, step-children or adopted children.

Personal identity fraud: Help and advice to reclaim your identity, including administrative costs or legal representation if needed.

Vehicle cloning: Support if your vehicle registration is cloned and defence of any resulting legal action.

Tax investigation: If HM Revenue & Customs conduct an examination which includes all areas of your self-assessment tax return.

Jury service: Payment of your salary while you attend a court or tribunal at the request of the lawyer we have appointed for you, or do jury service.

Legal defence:
- Defence for criminal prosecutions or certain civil actions against you as an employee.
- A formal investigation or disciplinary hearing is brought against you by a professional or regulatory body.

Telephone helplines:
- Legal advice helplines
- Tax advice helplines
- Counselling
- Personal cyber and identity theft helplines
- Admiral Legal Depot

Alternative accommodation: Up to £50,000 for temporary accommodation for your family and pets if your home is not safe to live in following an insured event.

Replacement locks: Up to £1,000 if keys are lost or stolen.

Property owner's liability: Up to £1 Million for sums you and your family are legally liable for.

Underground services: Covering accidental damage to underground drains, pipes and cables and tanks.

title: Admiral Home Insurance Policy
subsection_headings: Both Buildings and Contents (Main cover exclusions)
text:
Empty homes: Loss or damage under many sections of your policy if your home is left unoccupied for more than 60 days.

People you know: Malicious damage, theft or attempted theft caused by you, your family or anybody invited into the property unless force and violence has been used to enter your home.

Non-storm conditions: We will not pay for loss or damage from wind, rain, snow, or sleet unless caused by a storm, as defined in the policy booklet.

Escape of water: As the result of taps being left on (this may be covered if you have added Accidental Damage Cover).

Pets: Loss or damage caused by chewing, scratching, tearing, fouling or vomiting by domestic pets.

Gradually operating causes: Any loss or damage caused by anything that happens gradually including wear and tear.

title: Admiral Home Insurance Policy
section_heading: Are there any restrictions on cover?
text:
Limits: Limits apply to all sections of your policy. We will not pay more than the 'Unspecified item limit' for high risk items not listed individually on your Policy Schedule. High risk items are defined in your policy booklet.

Excesses: You must pay the first part of any claim (the excess). The excess is made up of the Compulsory excess, plus your chosen Voluntary excess. The excess for Subsidence, Escape of Water and Flood replace the compulsory excess. Your compulsory excess amount and all other excesses are shown on your Policy Schedule.

Extra conditions: Such as minimum security requirements (use of your locks and security devices) may apply. If applicable, these will appear on your Policy Schedule. If you do not keep to Extra Conditions it could affect your claim settlement.

Matching Suites: We will treat an individual item from a matching set of items as a single item. We will only pay for items that are lost or damaged but not for the other pieces of the set or suite which are not damaged or lost.
